categories.main_business_segments: EPAM operates through three main reportable segments: North America, Europe, and Russia (with Russia being phased out as of 2022). The company organizes its business primarily by geographic responsibility for client relationships, which closely aligns with customer locations. Each segment is responsible for delivering a broad range of digital platform engineering, software development, and consulting services to clients in its region.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: EPAM leverages its heritage in software engineering and product development, utilizing agile methodologies, proprietary global delivery platforms, and engineering excellence tools. The company integrates advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, robotics, virtual reality, and process automation, and employs a global delivery model with distributed teams and specialized project management tools to ensure quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EPAM serves a geographically diverse client base across multiple industries, with a focus on five main verticals: Financial Services; Travel & Consumer; Software & Hi-Tech; Business Information & Media; and Life Sciences & Healthcare. The company also targets emerging verticals such as energy, telecommunications, automotive, manufacturing, and government, providing tailored solutions to both large enterprises and innovative startups.
categories.geographic_coverage: EPAM has a global footprint, with key operations in North America (especially the United States), Europe (notably the UK, Switzerland, Netherlands, Germany, and Poland), and Asia-Pacific. Its largest delivery centers are in Ukraine, Belarus, India, and Poland, with ongoing expansion into Central and Eastern Europe, Central and Western Asia, India, and Latin America. The company is exiting Russia and continues to operate in Belarus with contingency plans.
categories.supply_chain_position: EPAM operates as a downstream provider in the IT services and digital transformation supply chain, delivering end-to-end solutions directly to enterprise clients. The company focuses on consulting, design, engineering, and managed services, integrating technology platforms and business processes for its customers rather than supplying raw materials or intermediate technology components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: EPAM's strategic priorities include expanding its service offerings beyond traditional software engineering into business consulting, design, and physical product development, with a strong emphasis on digital transformation, AI, automation, and experience design. The company invests heavily in R&D, innovation labs, and employee training, and pursues strategic acquisitions to enhance capabilities and geographic reach.
categories.revenue_model: EPAM primarily generates revenue through professional services billed on a time-and-materials or fixed-price basis, with the majority under time-and-materials contracts. Additional revenue streams include maintenance and support arrangements, licensing, and managed services, with a small portion from software licensing and other sources. The company emphasizes long-term client relationships and repeat business.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EPAM competes with global technology solutions providers such as Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte Digital, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, and others, as well as regional and boutique firms. The company differentiates itself through deep technical expertise, complex software product development, and a reputation for high-quality, on-time delivery, positioning itself as a leader in digital transformation and engineering services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, EPAM reported revenues of $4.825 billion, representing a 28.4% year-over-year increase, with strong growth across all major verticals and geographies except Russia. The company employs approximately 59,300 people, with over 52,850 delivery professionals. Despite geopolitical and macroeconomic challenges, EPAM has demonstrated sustained double-digit growth and maintains a robust balance sheet with significant cash reserves.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EPAM's value proposition centers on delivering complex, innovative, and scalable digital solutions that drive real business value for clients. The company emphasizes its engineering excellence, global delivery model, deep industry expertise, and ability to integrate strategy, design, and technology. EPAM is recognized for its ability to solve complex technical challenges, provide end-to-end transformation, and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships.
